sourceColorPolicy.baseColor: sRGB; remove directional light and baked highlights before production use
sourceColorPolicy.dataMaps: linear; never sample roughness, AO, height, masks or normal as sRGB
sourceColorPolicy.sourceImageRole: licensed visual source/reference; not asserted tileable or PBR-calibrated

channels.normal: tangent-space OpenGL +Y; Unity Normal Map importer; flip green only if a target shader requires DirectX -Y

textureImport.wrap: Repeat for base surfaces; Clamp for transition/decal masks

lodPolicy.LOD0: 0-15 m: full base + normal + roughness/mask + near detail where declared
lodPolicy.LOD1: 15-40 m: base + half-strength normal + roughness; fade near detail
lodPolicy.LOD2: 40-80 m: base + macro variation; no micro normal
lodPolicy.LOD3: 80-180 m: macro color/roughness only, target 512 mip residency
lodPolicy.Cull: >180 m: use terrain/far-surface aggregate, no unique sub-asset sampling
lodPolicy.note: Distance bands are authoring targets, not measured performance acceptance.

streamingPolicy.validation: Confirm actual imported format, residency and GPU memory in target-player profiling; manifest values are budgets only.

blendContract.wetness: changes base value slightly, lowers roughness and normal strength; never blue-tints the whole surface
blendContract.macroVariation: world-space low-frequency mask; do not rely only on random UV rotation
